AvoidDuplicationCard.title: Avoid duplication
AvoidDuplicationCard.body: By matching the works sent by creators and works sent by publishers, Matching Engine avoids duplication of the same or slightly different information in the repertoire management system.

ComplyWithInternationalStandards.title: Comply with international standards
ComplyWithInternationalStandards.body: The system complies with international metadata and encoding standards (ISWC, ISRC, DDEX, Unicode), and supports multilingual and non-latin script works.

RunAnalyticsAndQueries.title: Run analytics and queries
RunAnalyticsAndQueries.body: Collective Management Organisations can use Rest API to integrate other parts of their system. Its full data lakehouse gives access to underlying repertoire data to run analytics and queries.

ManageDifferentCollectionSharePictures.title: Manage different collection share pictures
ManageDifferentCollectionSharePictures.body: Matching Engine is designed to manage different collection share pictures based on territories and right types. This includes advanced support for carve outs and carve ins.

MinimiseManualIntervention.title: Minimise manual intervention
MinimiseManualIntervention.body: Advanced agreement support facilitates implementation of direct licensing carve outs and carve ins, without manual intervention on a work-by-work basis.

CollectDirectMemberRegistrations.title: Collect direct-member registrations
CollectDirectMemberRegistrations.body: Built in member portal supports work and agreement registration, advanced work agreement and cue sheet registration.
